title: Introduce stability anchor metric + rate-limited eval-retry CI hook
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a stability-anchor metric for cohort-level regressions and a rate-limited retry hook to reduce flakey CI failures. No API or public evaluation schema changes. Backwards-compatible config keys added under eval.hooks.retry.
description: Context: CI flakiness from intermittent evaluation timeouts and transient model output variance has been causing noisy regressions. This PR adds two complementary mitigations: (1) stability-anchor metric: a deterministic-sampling + anchored-seed snapshot that measures per-cohort stable-answer rate over time and surfaces regressions even with small sample sizes; (2) rate-limited eval-retry hook: a configurable CI hook that will retry failing eval cohorts with exponential backoff and a maximum retry budget to avoid transient failures causing CI-level gating. Includes a compact smoke reporter that emits cohort-level pass/fail + jitter stats to the CI summary. Changes are behind default-enabled feature flags and documented with sample config. Checklist: - [x] Implement stability-anchor metric and persistence of anchor snapshots - [x] Implement rate-limited retry hook and backoff policy - [x] Add unit tests for anchor stability computation and retry logic - [x] Add e2e smoke reporter for CI summaries - [x] Update docs and config examples (eval/docs/hooks.md) - [x] Run bench on internal canary workload and validate reduced false-positive rate Links: Linear ENG-11234; support ticket SUP-2048.
